create_SpotDemoAgent: create a SpotDemoAgent instance with parameters dict, spot config, optional dock id and output path
run_SpotDemoAgent_run_task: run a VLM-driven pick and place task on the Spot robot using a language command prompt
run_SpotDemoAgent_run_explore: run autonomous frontier-based exploration on the Spot robot for a configurable number of steps
run_SpotDemoAgent_navigate_to_an_instanc: navigate the Spot robot to a detected object instance using RRT motion planning
run_SpotDemoAgent_plan_to_frontier: plan a path from the current robot position to the nearest unexplored frontier point
